name: gpa-conversion-tables
description: Official CGPA/GPA-to-percentage conversion formulas for Indian universities (CBSE, VTU, SPPU, Anna, GTU, KTU, MAKAUT, Mumbai, AKTU, DU, JNTUH), HEC Pakistan, and the German modified Bavarian formula — as documented by StudentKit.
notes: All formulas take a CGPA on the stated scale and return a percentage.
Universities publish their own conversion rules; a generic table is never authoritative for official paperwork. Always confirm with your exam cell.
Interactive calculators for every rule below: https://www.studentkit.tech/tools/cgpa-to-percentage-calculator

Row 'german-modified-bavarian' is a general German convention (Uni-Assist), kept for completeness; it is not documented on a dedicated StudentKit page — every other row is verified against its linked StudentKit page.
